title: When checking the tar header, the check field is temporarily treated as a space.
summary: The chksum of ustar is the unsigned byte sum of the entire 512-byte header, and the eight bytes of the field itself are treated as spaces when calculating.
detail: If you directly add the octal checksum text stored in the header to the sum, you will get different results.
boundary: This verification only covers the header and cannot verify whether the actual data of the member is intact.
relevance: Distinguish between incorrect use of header verification algorithm and actual file data corruption.
